preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if node] + [node.right for node in [root] if node]) if root is not None
preconditions.description: Every node in the BST must be a valid TreeNode instance, with left and right children (if any) also being TreeNode instances.

preconditions.expression: all(node.val >= 0 for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if node] + [node.right for node in [root] if node]) if root is not None
preconditions.description: Every node's value must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(node.val == sum(node2.val for node2 in [root] + [node2.left for node2 in [root] if node2] + [node2.right for node2 in [root] if node2] if node2.val > node.val) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if node] + [node.right for node in [root] if node]) if root is not None
postconditions.description: For every node in the transformed BST, its value must equal the sum of all nodes in the original BST with values strictly greater than its original value.

postconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
postconditions.description: The returned root must be either None or a valid TreeNode instance.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [return_value] + [node.left for node in [return_value] if node] + [node.right for node in [return_value] if node]) if return_value is not None
postconditions.description: Every node in the returned BST must be a valid TreeNode instance, with left and right children (if any) also being TreeNode instances.
